h2_kernet2_faithfulness.reference_semantics: published KerNet2 (40x40 binary image route) output, paired with its own input contour in the same file — a clean input->output pair for the ported network

figure8_network_faithfulness.reference_semantics: official network output for the SAME network we ported
figure8_network_faithfulness.input_provenance_caveat: Deposited shapes[i].c is a RAW 384-point GAN display contour (not centred, non-uniform arc length), not the exact normalised input the authors fed the network. A small residual is expected from re-resampling this display contour and is an input-provenance effect, not a port bug; skipping the resample collapses agreement to ~0.56, confirming the pipeline is required and correct.

orientation.note: getShapeComp22netkeras.m enforces clockwise (lines 9-13); the port keeps that official step. On Figure 8 it is a near-no-op because almost all deposited contours are already clockwise, so it cannot explain the residual.

h1_approximation_to_original_shapecomp.reference_semantics: ORIGINAL 91-descriptor ShapeComp 22-D MDS coordinates, NOT a Keras network output (view_rating_expt_stim_and_resp.m line 21). This measures how well the neural approximation tracks the original model — explicitly NOT port faithfulness.
